# Athena OS
> Athena OS is an open-source, self-hosted no-code AI training and visual inspection platform across photos, video, audio, handwriting, documents, motion, and spreadsheets. Apache-2.0.

## Start here
- [Home](https://dominicmathew240.github.io/Athena-OS/): Public landing page and interactive multimodal studio + docs wiki (no backend)
- [Portfolio](https://dominic.strateticsxp.com/): Ts. Dominic Mathew, Co-Founder and CTO of Stratetics Experts
- [Inspec-Ther](https://inspec-ther.com/): AI-driven thermal inspection of solar PV assets

## Capabilities & Roadmap
- Today: plain-language inspection of photos and 6-frame video clips, plus custom object detector training
- Multimodal Roadmap (Waves 0-4): Computer Vision, Acoustic AI, Handwriting OCR (TrOCR), Documents & NLP, Spreadsheets & Signals, Human Pose & Gestures, and Wave 4 Cross-modal Fusion
- Shared Resource Lifecycle: Project -> Task -> Observation -> Annotation -> Dataset Version -> Training Run -> Model Version -> Evaluation -> Deployment -> Feedback
- Built-in open Qwen vision model or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, running on local CPU/GPU or optional Athena Nodes

## Athena Vision
In-house Segment and Detect models for assisted annotation: label one picture, then review AI drafts on the rest. Bounding boxes, masks, and export to COCO, YOLO or VOC. This is the vision stack behind Inspec-Ther.

## Related product
Inspec-Ther is the solar inspection product. Athena Vision (Segment and Detect) is the in-house vision stack behind it. This page is the open-source Athena OS toolkit, not the hosted Inspec-Ther app.

## Access
This site is a static page. There is no account, API or cloud service here. See the portfolio for the work and the products.
